resources.notes: API fully reachable, every query HTTP 200. CRITICAL SEARCH-SYNTAX FINDING: multi-word queries are OR-combined by default, so 'antisense oligonucleotide platelet' returns 5416 hits of pure noise; explicit 'AND' is required (that same concept with AND returns 71). Quoted phrases do NOT work ('"antisense oligonucleotide" AND platelet' returns 0 while the unquoted AND form returns hits), so phrase search is unavailable. The index also auto-expands EFO synonyms (platelet -> blood platelet/enucleate thrombocyte/anucleate thrombocyte), reported in the response's expandedEfoTerms field. SUBSTANTIVE FINDING: every single oligonucleotide drug alias (oblimersen, G3139, Genasense, drisapersen, GSK2402968, PRO051, aprinocarsen, ISIS3521, LY900003, ISIS5132, alicaforsen, ISIS2302, donidalorsen, pelacarsen, TQJ230, olezarsen, nusinersen, eteplirsen, golodirsen, viltolarsen, casimersen, mipomersen, volanesorsen, inotersen) returns ZERO primary experimental datasets - all hits are S-EPMC literature-mirror records. BioStudies holds no primary oligonucleotide-platelet dataset. All 11 relevant results are S-EPMC mirror records whose value is their attached supplementary files, not deposited data. The documented /api/v1/collections endpoint returns HTTP 404 ({'errorMessage':'Study not found'}), so collection names could not be enumerated and had to be guessed; only 'arrayexpress' resolved (collection=biostudies, BioStudies, bsst, BSST, default all return totalHits=0).

queries: Duchenne AND exon skipping AND platelet
resources.notes: Collection is live and queryable (bare 'platelet' returns 172 records, totalHits exact). Every query HTTP 200; no access barrier. EXHAUSTIVELY NEGATIVE for this endpoint. All 24 oligonucleotide drug aliases return 0 hits except 'oblimersen', whose single hit E-GEOD-58613 I retrieved and read: it is 'A translatable predictor of human radiation injury', a radiation-biodosimetry transcriptomics study with no oligonucleotide exposure - a spurious fuzzy/stemmed match, NOT an oblimersen dataset. I triaged every non-mirror accession returned by the specific (AND-joined) queries by pulling its title: the recurring hits are platelet transcriptomics with no oligonucleotide exposure (E-MTAB-715 human platelet polyA-mRNA, E-GEOD-27917 platelet miRNA-mRNA/reactivity, E-GEOD-50858 reference platelet transcriptome, E-GEOD-44093 platelet miRNA in T2DM, E-MTAB-13864 platelets and metastasis), murine megakaryocyte studies (E-GEOD-15581, E-GEOD-6593, E-GEOD-22480), haematological-malignancy arrays where 'thrombocytopenia' is only a patient descriptor (E-MTAB-4623, E-TABM-1014, E-TABM-1015, E-GEOD-47018), or gapmer/ASO-as-a-tool knockdown transcriptomics with no platelet readout at all (E-MTAB-6529 HeLa GapmeR, E-MTAB-13920, E-MTAB-13925, E-MTAB-16823, E-MTAB-3198, E-MTAB-12462, E-MTAB-11818, E-MTAB-13323, E-MTAB-17232, E-GEOD-45157, E-GEOD-70300, E-GEOD-76741, E-GEOD-70177). 'ODN2395' hits E-GEOD-26864/E-GEOD-28994 which are mouse lung TLR-ligand studies, not platelet. CONCLUSION: ArrayExpress contains no transcriptomic dataset of oligonucleotide-exposed platelets or megakaryocytes, human or animal. This is a genuine absence, not a barrier.

resources.resource: BioStudies S-EPMC literature-mirror collection (PMC article records with mirrored supplementary files)
queries: single-stranded AND oligonucleotide AND vitro AND platelet
direct record lookup: S-EPMC13571576 (OMTN 2026 cASO controls)
resources.notes: This is where all value in my family sits, and it is NOT a primary-data resource: S-EPMC records are a mirror of PMC articles, so they are a RETRIEVAL ROUTE for supplementary files, not datasets. 583 distinct S-EPMC records were enumerated across 30 queries. Each record exposes resolved primary identifiers (DOI, PMID, PMC, and often NCT) as typed links, which let me satisfy the rule on resolving to primary IDs without leaving this family. Confirmed already-staged: S-EPMC5673186 = Sewing 2017 (its one file pone.0187574.s001.xlsx is 54955 bytes, byte-identical in size to the staged sewing2017_pone.0187574_S1.xlsx) and S-EPMC10143489 = Valenzuela 2023 minipig. NOT MIRRORED (HTTP 404 on the record): S-EPMC8804562 (Slingsby 2022), S-EPMC13571576 (OMTN 2026 cASO control sequences - so this family cannot supply a clean replacement for the staged corrupt 27 MB zip), S-EPMC5467133 (Crooke 2017). S-EPMC4322051 (Flierl 2015, 'Phosphorothioate backbone modifications ... are potent platelet activators') has a record but ZERO attached files. Best new find: S-EPMC8264460 = Zaslavsky 2021, whose 4 supplemental figure PDFs were absent from the staging directory (which held only the full text) and which I retrieved and content-verified as human platelet aggregation data.

resources.url: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/ (S-BSST series; reached via api/v1/search and collection= probes)
queries: platelet AND flow cytometry AND donor
resources.notes: Searched as its own row because it is the only part of BioStudies that holds author-deposited primary data rather than mirrored literature or array experiments. Across every platelet/oligonucleotide/thrombocytopenia query run in the all-collections scope, NOT ONE S-BSST accession appeared in any result set (the non-mirror hits were exclusively E-* ArrayExpress accessions plus one Cell Model Passports record, S-CMO1117, a cutaneous-melanoma cell line irrelevant to this endpoint). I could not restrict to the collection by name: collection=biostudies, BioStudies, bsst, BSST and default each return totalHits=0, and the /api/v1/collections enumeration endpoint is broken (HTTP 404), so the correct collection token is undiscoverable from the API. The negative result is therefore established from the unrestricted searches rather than from a collection-scoped query. Honest reading: no author has deposited raw platelet-oligonucleotide data (donor-level aggregometry, flow cytometry, PAC-1/P-selectin/GPVI) into BioStudies. This is the single most important negative in my family, because raw per-donor human in vitro data is exactly what Phase 2 prioritises.

resources.barrier_detail: No access barrier: every requested file returned HTTP 200 with correct content-type and full byte count, no login, no CAPTCHA, no rate limiting. The ONLY failing variant was the api/v1-prefixed path /biostudies/api/v1/files/... which returns HTTP 404 with an HTML error page (14751 bytes); the correct path has no api/v1 prefix.
resources.notes: SERIOUS DATA-INTEGRITY DEFECT FOUND AND VERIFIED - must be flagged to any downstream curator. The mirror stores supplementary files under their ORIGINAL publisher filenames, which for generic names COLLIDE across PMC articles, and the endpoint then serves a file from the WRONG paper under the requested accession with a clean HTTP 200. Proven twice by reading the delivered content: (1) https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/files/S-EPMC8713270/Supp_TableS1.docx returns a list of HIV patient samples with dates/ages/sexes; Supp_TableS2.docx returns an OVID Medline search strategy about SMS/text messaging; Supp_TableS3.docx returns a medical-cannabis autoregressive linear mixed model table - none belong to the Crooke 2'-MOE tolerability paper. (2) https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/files/S-EPMC8246029/mmc1.docx returns a Bjchitinase multiple-sequence-alignment legend, not the IONIS-AGT-LRx phase 1/2 supplement. By contrast files with paper-specific names (NIHMS1711667-*, NIHMS2093392-*, pone.0161955.*, BRB3-15-e70221-*, supp_WNL.0000000000000926_*, 41598_2024_64063_*, Supp_TableS4/S5/S6.docx) were all verified as correct-paper content. OPERATIONAL RULE: never trust a file from this endpoint without opening it and matching its content to the cited paper. I deleted the 4 wrong-provenance files I had downloaded rather than leave them in staging. 19 content-verified files retained (see the notes field of the overall record for the full filename/bytes/sha256 manifest).

candidates.full_title: Antisense oligonucleotides and nucleic acids generate hypersensitive platelets
candidates.authors_year: Zaslavsky A, Adams M, Cao X, Yamaguchi A, Henderson J, Busch-Ostergren P, Udager A, Pitchiaya S, Tourdot B, Kasputis T, Church SJ, Lee SK, Ohl S, Patel A, Morgan TM, Kunju LP, Chinnaiyan AM, Holinstat M, Palapattu GS; 2021
candidates.discovered_via: BioStudies direct record lookup S-EPMC8264460 after 'oligonucleotide AND platelet' / 'phosphorothioate AND platelet' sweeps; confirmed the staging directory held only this paper's full text and no supplement
candidates.publisher_or_repo: Thrombosis Research (Elsevier) / NIH author manuscript NIHMS1711667, mirrored in EBI BioStudies S-EPMC collection
candidates.endpoint_gap_it_closes: Human in vitro platelet hypersensitivity to PS-ASOs - the exact Phase 2 priority class. Content verified by text extraction: Supplemental Figures 1, 2 and 4 report 'Max. platelet aggregation (%) induced by 0.1 nM thrombin' for untreated platelets vs + gDNA (24 uM) vs + miRNA (24 uM) vs + protein (24 uM) vs + ASO (24 uM) with and without a TLR inhibitor, with significance marks (ns, **, ***); Supplemental Figure 2 explicitly labels 'human platelets'; Supplemental Figure 3 is a PS-ASO vs gDNA aggregation panel (vehicle control / PS-ASO / gDNA, 0-15%). Supplies a sub-threshold-agonist potentiation readout and an explicit nucleic-acid-class comparator set (PS-ASO vs genomic DNA vs miRNA vs protein) plus TLR-dependence, i.e. mechanism, which the existing dataset lacks. Also closes a staging gap: only the full text was previously held.
candidates.expected_usable_observations: ~25-45 condition-level human platelet aggregation observations (treatment x concentration x +/- TLR inhibitor across 4 figures). Figure-level group means with significance marks, NOT per-donor raw values - the PDFs are vector figures, so values must be read off axes or digitised; donor n is stated in the main text, not the figures.

candidates.full_title: Physiological platelet aggregation assay to mitigate drug-induced thrombocytopenia using a microphysiological system
candidates.authors_year: Harada K, Wenlong W, Shinozawa T; 2024
candidates.discovered_via: BioStudies search 'microphysiological AND platelet' (2 hits) and 'platelet aggregation AND oligonucleotide' (top hit)
candidates.publisher_or_repo: Scientific Reports (Springer Nature, open access) mirrored in EBI BioStudies S-EPMC collection
candidates.required_file: Main text tables/figures for the concentration-response data (open access in PMC). 41598_2024_64063_MOESM1_ESM.pptx RETRIEVED but content-verified as LOW VALUE - it is a single slide containing only Supplementary Fig. 1, a schematic of blood flow and laminar flow in the MPS chamber, with no numeric data.
candidates.endpoint_gap_it_closes: Human in vitro / ex vivo platelet aggregation under physiological shear, which is the top-ranked Phase 2 evidence class and is a genuinely different platform from static aggregometry. The abstract states remarkable platelet aggregate formation in platelet-rich plasma at 30 ug/mL and in whole blood at 3 ug/mL, and that ODN2395 (an oligonucleotide) induced platelet aggregation and adhesion to vascular endothelial cells, with SYK implicated. Gives a human PRP-vs-whole-blood sensitivity ratio and an oligonucleotide-vs-endothelium adhesion endpoint, neither of which the existing dataset has, and ODN2395 is a characterisable CpG-class oligonucleotide.
candidates.expected_usable_observations: ~10-30 human in vitro observations (ODN2395 and comparator compounds x concentration x PRP/whole blood x aggregation/adhesion readout). Chemistry caveat: ODN2395 is a CpG-class immunostimulatory ODN, so its backbone/sequence must be recorded from the vendor specification rather than assumed to be a therapeutic gapmer.

candidates.discovered_via: BioStudies all-collections sweep (surfaced among S-EPMC records carrying supplementary files for the antisense/platelet queries)
candidates.publisher_or_repo: Neurology (AAN) mirrored in EBI BioStudies S-EPMC collection
candidates.endpoint_gap_it_closes: Adds a 2'-MOE PS ASO (ATL1102 / ISIS 107248, targeting CD49d/VLA-4) that is NOT in the priority list, with an unusually high and well-characterised thrombocytopenia signal plus a placebo denominator. Content verified by docx text extraction: Table e-1 gives Thrombocytopenia 8 (22.2%) in ATL1102 N=36 versus 0 in Placebo N=41, and the footnote adds mechanism-relevant detail that the existing dataset usually lacks: 'There was a drop in platelets by at least one third of starting levels in 4 subjects and to below the lower limit of normal (LLN) in 4 subjects. That gives a reversibility statement, a graded severity split (>=1/3 drop vs <LLN) and a discontinuation count. The paper is cited in the already-staged Crooke 2017 full text, so the trial is known to the project, but this supplementary table is the source of the per-arm numbers.
candidates.expected_usable_observations: ~8-14 trial-level observations (thrombocytopenia incidence for 2 arms with denominators, plus 4 + 4 subjects split by severity band, 2 discontinuations, and a reversibility outcome). Summary-level, not per-subject.

notes:
FAMILY VERDICT. BioStudies and ArrayExpress hold NO primary experimental dataset on oligonucleotide-induced thrombocytopenia or oligonucleotide-induced platelet activation - not one, in either collection, for any of the 24 drug aliases searched. Every drug alias query (oblimersen, G3139, Genasense, drisapersen, GSK2402968, PRO051, aprinocarsen, ISIS3521, LY900003, ISIS5132, alicaforsen, ISIS2302, donidalorsen, pelacarsen, TQJ230, olezarsen, nusinersen, eteplirsen, golodirsen, viltolarsen, casimersen, mipomersen, volanesorsen, inotersen) returned either zero hits or only S-EPMC literature-mirror records. The one apparent exception, ArrayExpress E-GEOD-58613 for 'oblimersen', I retrieved and read: it is a radiation-biodosimetry study with no oligonucleotide exposure, i.e. a spurious match. No S-BSST (author-deposited) record appeared for any platelet or oligonucleotide query, which means the raw per-donor human in vitro data that Phase 2 most wants has not been deposited here. This is a genuine scientific absence, NOT an access barrier: the API was fully available throughout and every search returned HTTP 200.

WHERE THE VALUE ACTUALLY CAME FROM. All 12 candidates are S-EPMC records, i.e. BioStudies acting as a free, legal MIRROR OF PMC SUPPLEMENTARY FILES. That is a retrieval route, not a data repository, and I have labelled it as such rather than dressing mirror records up as datasets. Its one real advantage is that it exposes typed DOI/PMID/PMC/NCT links on each record, so candidates could be resolved to primary identifiers without leaving the family; I independently verified all 6 NCT numbers I report (NCT01737398, NCT01910649, NCT03101878, NCT03394144, NCT03714776, NCT04083222) against the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API, each HTTP 200.

BEST FINDS, IN PRIORITY ORDER. (1) Zaslavsky 2021 (PMC8264460) - 4 supplemental figure PDFs of HUMAN platelet aggregation with PS-ASO at 24 uM versus gDNA, miRNA and protein controls, with TLR-inhibitor dependence; the staging directory previously held only this paper's full text, so this is a true gap closure and the only HUMAN IN VITRO data my family delivered. (2) Inotersen NEURO-TTR supplementary appendix (PMC12611561, NIHMS2093392) - Figure S11 mean platelet count over time, Table S10 confirmed platelet-count decrease banded for Placebo N=60 vs Inotersen N=112, the <125 x 10^9/L threshold, and a Grade 4 thrombocytopenia intracranial-haemorrhage narrative at ~10 x 10^9/L; an NIH author manuscript, so openly available where the NEJM supplement normally is not. (3) Drisapersen OLE (PMC5010191) S3 Table - thrombocytopenia 4/12 (33%) continuous versus 2/12 (17%) interrupted dosing, closing part of the named drisapersen gap. (4) ATL1102 (PMC4240428) Table e-1 - thrombocytopenia 8/36 (22.2%) vs 0/41 placebo plus a reversibility and severity-band footnote, adding a 2'-MOE PS ASO that was not on the priority list at all.

CRITICAL WARNING FOR DOWNSTREAM CURATION - WRONG-FILE DELIVERY. The BioStudies file endpoint serves supplementary files under original publisher filenames, and generic names COLLIDE across PMC articles: the endpoint then returns a file from a DIFFERENT paper under the requested accession with a clean HTTP 200 and no warning. I proved this twice by opening the delivered content. S-EPMC8713270/Supp_TableS1.docx is an HIV patient sample list, Supp_TableS2.docx is an OVID Medline search strategy about SMS text messaging, and Supp_TableS3.docx is a medical-cannabis mixed-models table - none belong to the Crooke 2'-MOE paper. S-EPMC8246029/mmc1.docx is a Bjchitinase sequence-alignment legend, not the IONIS-AGT-LRx supplement. Files with paper-specific names (NIHMS1711667-*, NIHMS2093392-*, pone.0161955.*, BRB3-15-e70221-*, supp_WNL.0000000000000926_*, 41598_2024_64063_*, Supp_TableS4/S5/S6) were all correct. RULE: never trust a file from this endpoint without opening it and matching content to the cited paper. I deleted the 4 wrong-provenance files rather than leave them in staging to be mis-curated later.

CLAIMS I AM NOT MAKING. I did not verify the platelet content of S-EPMC7496583 (inotersen OLE, 5 docx), S-EPMC3048191 (lipid-siRNA NP, 7 doc) or S-EPMC9594513 (danvatirsen, supp001.pdf) - these are listed as located and addressable, not retrieved, and their expected observation counts are explicitly marked unknown. The Harada 2024 supplement I DID download turned out to be only a schematic of the MPS chamber with no numeric data, so that candidate's value rests on its open-access main text, not on anything my family supplied. The nusinersen supplements (S-EPMC11743982) I downloaded and opened contain urine protein, urine creatinine and motor scores only, with zero platelet strings, despite the paper's title promising haematological parameters.

ALSO NOT AVAILABLE HERE. Three priority papers are simply not mirrored, each returning HTTP 404 on the record lookup: Slingsby 2022 (S-EPMC8804562), the OMTN 2026 cASO control-sequence paper (S-EPMC13571576) and Crooke 2017 (S-EPMC5467133). So this family cannot supply a clean replacement for the staged corrupt 27 MB omtn2026 supplement zip, and cannot supply the cASO7/cASO9/cASO11 sequences from Table S2. Flierl 2015 (S-EPMC4322051, 'Phosphorothioate backbone modifications ... are potent platelet activators') has a mirror record but zero attached files. Sewing 2017 (S-EPMC5673186) is mirrored with exactly the one 54955-byte xlsx already staged, so nothing new there.

SEARCH-SYNTAX CAVEAT AFFECTING RECALL. This index OR-combines bare multi-word queries and does not support quoted phrases ('"antisense oligonucleotide" AND platelet' returns 0 while the unquoted AND form returns hits), and it silently expands EFO synonyms. My first sweep was therefore invalid and was discarded and re-run with explicit AND. Residual risk: because phrase search is impossible, a record using only an unusual alias in free text could have been missed. The documented /api/v1/collections endpoint is broken (HTTP 404), so I could not enumerate collection names and had to probe them; only 'arrayexpress' resolved.
